description: It reads one report of a webinar as one piece: single values such as registrations, attendance and conversion, plus the rows behind them. You pick the report: funnel (visitor to registration to attendance to offer), mail_waves (what the live send and the evergreen daily send delivered) or leads (the people with attendance and purchase). Take it when a host wants the numbers in one table, or when the question is about the mail waves, which no other report shows. "Send me a report of the last run." It only reads and changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: webinar report, funnel, leads report, mail waves, numbers

range.description: The period, as the site names it, e.g. 7d, 30d or all.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

type.description: Which report to read. Leave it out to list the report types of this installation.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out to list the report types.

name: wi_get_webinar_report
title: Read a report of a webinar
